name: Machine Oracle
function: Chief, reasoning, planning, decisions and system control.
responsibility: Chief status, reasoning requests, plans, pending approvals, decision history, safety review and provider status.

name: Memory Vault
function: Archive, preservation, provenance, version history and restoration.
responsibility: Global archival access, canonical records, superseded decisions, version history, restore and provenance.

name: Astral Greenhouse / Gardens
function: Visual discovery, browsing, inspiration, evolving work and asset selection.
responsibility: Cross-World visual discovery, work-in-progress review, inspiration boards, asset candidates and links into each World's own immersive gallery.
mustNotBecome: The only gallery; each World still has its own gallery.

name: Throne Reactor
function: System engine, configuration, automation and power controls.
responsibility: Settings, providers, automations, permissions, feature flags, system state, integration health and controlled maintenance.

name: Void Railway
function: Navigation and transport between Project Worlds.
responsibility: World directory, recent Worlds, route transitions, resume state, deep links and World creation proposals subject to approval.

name: Observatory
function: Overviews, analytics, long-range planning and project status.
responsibility: Atlas-wide project inventory, progress, activity, deadlines, risks, blockers, stale projects and strategic review.

name: Cosmic Aquarium
function: Video, sound and media files that do not yet have a correct dedicated space.
responsibility: Media index, preview metadata, unplaced media queue and reassignment into a correct World when one is identified.

name: Leviathan Spine
function: Structural backbone, infrastructure and foundational systems.
responsibility: Storage providers, file references, repository links, schemas, indexing, relationship graph, backups, validation and diagnostics.

name: Eclipse Monastery
responsibility: Personal systems, reflection, routines, development plans and the experiential interface to relevant Chief outputs.
mustNotBecome: Chief itself or a medical decision-maker.
